summary: Split apps/agent-server/tests/sessions/pi-agent-service.test.ts (553 LOC) into three semantically named test files (creation, commands, events) each under 300 LOC, extracting reusable typed fixtures (FakePiSession, createTestService, piEvent) into apps/agent-server/tests/sessions/support/pi-agent-service-fixtures.ts. All 16 tests and 33 assertions were preserved with identical titles; prettier, tsc check, and vitest run (23 files / 114 tests) all passed.
decisions: Chose to place shared fixtures under apps/agent-server/tests/sessions/support/ rather than tests/support, keeping them co-located with the consumer tests.

Split along behavioral boundaries — creation/setup, command routing/compaction/attachments, and event translation/replay — rather than by line count, keeping each file semantically focused and ≤300 LOC.

Verified equivalence by comparing test titles and `expect(` counts between the old file (16 titles / 33 expects) and the combined new files (identical), confirming zero assertion loss during the split.
